messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Uncorrelated two factor model
parts:
Hi Ruby, 

To estimate the model with the factors uncorrelated you would add this line to your M0 model: 

F1~~0*F2

-Andrew

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Uncorrelated two factor model
parts:
Hi Ruby, 

The only way to produce summary statistics for a latent trait is through multivariate GWAS as you say. Following the steps outlined on the wiki, to do this you would need to run the sumstats function, followed by the userGWAS function. For your model, if you wanted to obtain the summary statistics for the SNP predicting F1 and F2 it would be written as:

M0 <- 'F1 =~ NA*CAD + SBP + LDL + LIFESPAN
      F2 =~ NA*BMI + T2D + TRI + CKD + LIFESPAN
      F1~~1*F1
      F2~~1*F2

F1~~0*F2
      F1~SNP
      F2~SNP'

-Andrew
